signal: On the last US equity session of the completed Dec/Mar/Jun/Sep calendar month, x=VIXclose^2/12-sum((100*ln(SPXclose/SPXprevious_session_close))^2) over all US equity sessions in that month. Select strictly x>0, else cash; missing values block.
timing: Decide at15:00 Asia/Shanghai on the first CN exchange session of each Jan/Apr/Jul/Oct; enter the second session09:30 open, exit next anchor. Assume the prior US month-end closing observations were available by18:00 America/New_York on their observation date and verify that timestamp precedes every decision.18:00 is a conservative research assumption, not an observed publisher timestamp; current retrieval is not historical availability proof.
price_basis: One raw ETF share, open-to-open plus declared gross cash for record dates entry<=record<exit, no cash reinvestment, receivables included. Annual no-split statements used conditionally. Fees, lot rounding, account cash and fills excluded at this screen.

statistics.primary: D=sum((z-z_bar)*log(1+y))/sum(n), with z_bar=sum(n*z)/sum(n), exchange-session durations n; descriptive matched-exposure gross effect per session.

bootstrap.kind: paired circular blocks of complete quarterly (z,y,n) observations

statistics.qualification: All required: at least6 selected and6 unselected quarters overall, at least3 selected and3 unselected in fixed2020onward subset; at least6 distinct selected runs overall and3 within the later subset; full D lower2.5percentile>0; full and later selected arithmetic means>0; later D>0. Run counts address the preceding study's persistent-state weakness; these are minimum research policies, not proof of independent samples or reliable bootstrap coverage.
statistics.report: Counts, positive gross interval frequency, arithmetic mean, D, confidence interval, annual contributions, state switches and distinct selected runs. No chosen parameter variants or reruns. A run crossing the later boundary counts as a later segment, explicitly not a new independent trade.
statistics.no_rescue: No changes to sign, zero threshold, proxy, phase, horizon, start/end, later split, block length, minimum counts or fees in response to this result.
statistics.limitations: Only45quarters/about11year blocks; structural dependence and2014VIX method change remain.2020-2024ETF outcomes used in previous studies. Formula/window fixed before US-source expansion; raw source levels and earlyOHLC quality checks precede this statistical contract. This is conditional exploration, not confirmatory untouched evidence.

if_passed: Separately register the CNY10000 net-account study, maxCNY1000 position, commissions0/5/10 and slippage0/10/30bp, main5CNY/10bp, carry holdings across adjacent selected quarters.
if_failed: Close this fixed hypothesis; insufficient evidence is not proof of negative population EV.
reviewer: Project lead self-review under autonomous mandate; no independent review claimed.
